title: Orbit of the split step
statement: For every Boolean word $w$ and natural number $i\le |w|+1$, applying the split-search step $i$ times to the empty word gives the unary word of length $i$.
replaced:
For every $i \le \abs{w} + 1$, the $i$-th iterate of the split-search step on
the empty candidate is the unary word $1^i$.
